versions.changelog:
Initial release of OSS Lifecycle Runtime & Archive Restore Diagnosis skill.

- Provides read-only diagnosis for OSS lifecycle rule issues and archive/cold archive/deep cold archive restore problems.
- Diagnoses lifecycle rule runtime, rule loading delays, prefix/tag mismatches, storage class transitions, versioning impacts, and restore or retrieval errors.
- Never performs write operations; outputs only evidence-based findings and advice, not actual OSS API calls or scripts.
- Absolutely prohibits handling access keys, issuing write requests, or bypassing provided scripts for diagnostics.
- All conclusions are grounded in live control-plane queries (GetBucketInfo, GetBucketVersioning, GetBucketLifecycle) and official documentation verification.
- Includes mandatory observability and reporting behaviors for error handling and degraded scenarios.
